import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { expect, it } from 'vitest';

it('holds the outer slot while the nested suites run', () => {
  expect(() => mkdirSync('outer-active')).not.toThrow();
  try {
    const result = spawnSync(
      process.execPath,
      [resolve('node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs'), 'run', 'tests/nested'],
      { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 10_000 }
    );
    expect(result.error, result.stdout + result.stderr).toBeUndefined();
    expect(result.status, result.stdout + result.stderr).toBe(0);
    writeFileSync('completed/outer-gitEnvironment.test.ts', 'finished');
  } finally {
    rmSync('outer-active', { recursive: true });
  }
});
